claims.statement: The pinned warning says the Classroom application is closing and will retire August 28, 2026, linking a sunset notice. This date precedes the current review; prior Classroom capability fragments are historical documentation, not proof of current service availability or deployable bindings. Actual retirement state, redirects, migration path and the linked notice require separate assurance; no live shutdown fact is certified by this fragment alone.

Assignment overview CSV export includes student repository link, GitHub handle, roster identifier, submission timestamp and autograding score. These identifying/educational fields require scoped privacy handling; export capability is not consent, complete roster coverage, valid grading or authority to collect real student records. No CSV was generated or downloaded.

The assignment-creation reference points separately to individual and group parent articles. Links do not inherit semantic review, establish current post-sunset capability or prove assignment creation.

The Codespaces Education benefit note is explicitly public-preview and subject to change, describing no organization charge for allowance excess during that preview. This conditional historical statement is not an enduring zero-cost guarantee, current entitlement or authorization to provision environments.

The source distinguishes Google Classroom from LTI-based systems: no preceding GitHub Classroom LTI connection is required to import its roster. This is not absence of authentication, privacy consent or import prerequisites; parent procedure and post-sunset support remain separate evidence.

Classroom creation selects the intended organization, optionally creates a new organization, enters a classroom name and clicks Create classroom. Optional organization creation is not a requirement or authority for account changes; the historic procedure does not establish current availability after the separate retirement notice.
